slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Told to keep walking with back pain, but nobody said how much?

Walking is one of the simplest ways to stay active with a sore back. The trick is finding your starting point: a time you can manage with only mild discomfort, even if that's five minutes.

From there, two or three short walks a day are often easier than one long one. Add a few minutes every few days, with a relaxed pace and arms swinging. In summer, early mornings or evenings are kinder.

Leg weakness or bladder and bowel changes need prompt medical care. If it isn't easing after a few weeks, our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can build a plan with you. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
